messages:
olivia: Heads-up — noticed async python SDK (0.12.4 -> 0.12.5) drops X-Request-ID from outgoing requests when OpenTelemetry context is active. App logs lose request-id, tracing still OK. Repro below.

raj: can you paste repro? which client usage?

olivia: here's minimal repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
import opentelemetry.trace as trace

async def main():
    tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="...")
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("root"):
        resp = await client.post("/v1/generate", json={"prompt":"hi"})
        print(resp.headers.get("X-Request-ID"))

# prints None on 0.12.5, prints 'req_...' on 0.12.4
```

ben: hmm likely contextvars propagation issue. We use contextvars for request id in middleware. Could be that async client uses a threadpool / asyncio.create_task fallback that loses context. Quick workaround: set header manually via client.default_headers. e.g.
```py
client = AsyncClient(...)
client.default_headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
```

emma: can we add better typing + async OTEL hook? Request-id propagation + typed span context in SDK would help. Also file an issue?

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/3421 — 'async python sdk drops request-id when OTEL active' (assigned: none)

olivia: thanks, fyi only happens when using `tracer.start_as_current_span` (sync API) — async context manager variant also reproduces. This regressed after commit 9c1a2b

raj: assign to @emma? Also can you paste stacktrace or headers capture from proxy?

olivia: proxy capture:
```
> POST /v1/generate
> headers:
>   authorization: Bearer ...
>   traceparent: 00-abc-...-01
>   x-request-id: 12345  # missing in 0.12.5
```

ben: probable fix: use opentelemetry instrumentation to attach request-id to contextvars, or wrap our async transport to preserve contextvars when creating tasks. I can prototype a fix that calls `contextvars.copy_context()` before scheduling.

emma: I'll do typings + opt-in telemetry integration PR. Will also add unit test for contextvar propagation and a small example for onboarding. ETA EOD tomorrow.

raj: SGTM. Assign ci-bot? @ci-bot please add label devex/async-otel and link PR template.

ci-bot: label added: devex/async-otel

olivia: awesome, thanks y'all :tada:
